zh.paste: 把想修改的图片放进来
zh.pasteHint: 粘贴截图、拖入图片，或从当前会话选择。
zh.selectHelp: 框选直接写批注，拖动选区调整位置；Shift 拖动可新建范围
zh.pointHelp: 点击画面写批注；已有标记可直接拖动，点击标记继续编辑
zh.selectHint: 框选即批注 · 拖动选区调整位置
zh.pointHint: 点击添加批注 · 拖动标记调整位置
zh.panHint: 拖动画布 · 也可使用空格或中键
zh.emptyNotes: 直接在图片上框选，意见会出现在这里。
zh.blockPlaceholder: 这个图块还想怎么改？（可选）
zh.optionalComment: 位置调整会自动回传，文字可留空
zh.accepted: 反馈已排队，原聊天草稿保持不变。
zh.inserted: 反馈文字已填入，尚未发送。
zh.fillFailed: 输入框状态已改变，未插入。请重试；原草稿未被覆盖。
zh.fillTextOnly: 只填入反馈文字；携带原图和布局参考请使用“发送反馈”。
zh.feedbackChanged: 准备参考图时反馈发生了变化，请重新发送。
zh.noImages: 当前会话还没有图片，可以直接粘贴或选择文件。
zh.unsupported: 请选择 PNG、JPEG、WebP 或 GIF 图片。
zh.invalidPaste: 未发现图片、有效图片路径或 Base64。文字请粘贴到意见框。
zh.deleteConfirm: 图块绑定了意见。确认同时移除图块和这些意见？
zh.newImageConfirm: 当前修改会先保存，切换后可从会话图片恢复。
zh.sendAgain: 这份反馈已经发送；修改后可以再次发送。
zh.sessionChanged: 会话已切换，反馈仍保留在原会话，未发送。
zh.commandDraft: 输入框中已有斜杠命令，请先完成或退出该命令，再填入反馈。
zh.reloadConfirm: 重新读取会放弃未保存的本地修改。建议先导出反馈 JSON。确认放弃并读取宿主版本？
zh.cutOverlap: 这个范围包含已被移动走的源像素，不能再次拆出同一份。请直接拖动当前可见图块；原有内容和意见已保留。
zh.keyboardHint: 空格 / 中键平移 · Ctrl/Cmd+Z 撤销 · 方向键微调图块

en.paste: Bring in an image to refine
en.pasteHint: Paste a screenshot, drop an image, or choose from this session.
en.selectHelp: Draw to write feedback, drag a region to move it; Shift-drag starts a new region
en.pointHelp: Click to write a point note; drag an existing pin to reposition it, or click to edit
en.selectHint: Draw to comment · Drag a region to move it
en.pointHint: Click to comment · Drag a pin to reposition it
en.panHint: Drag to pan · Space or middle button also works
en.emptyNotes: Draw a region on the image. Your feedback appears here.
en.placeholder: What would you like to change here?
en.blockPlaceholder: Any other changes to this block? (Optional)
en.optionalComment: Layout changes are included automatically; text is optional
en.accepted: Feedback queued. Your chat draft is unchanged.
en.fillFailed: The composer changed; nothing was inserted. Retry. Your draft was not overwritten.
en.fillTextOnly: Inserts text only. Use Send feedback to include the source and layout reference images.
en.feedbackChanged: Feedback changed while preparing the reference. Please retry.
en.noImages: No images in this session yet. Paste or choose an image.
en.unsupported: Choose a PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF image.
en.invalidPaste: No image, valid image path or Base64 found. Paste text into a feedback field.
en.deleteConfirm: This block has notes. Remove the block and its attached notes?
en.newImageConfirm: Current changes will be saved first. Reopen them from session images later.
en.sendAgain: This feedback was already sent. Edit it before sending again.
en.sessionChanged: The viewed session changed. Feedback remains in the original session and was not sent.
en.commandDraft: The composer contains a slash command. Finish or clear that command before inserting feedback.
en.reloadConfirm: Reload discards unsaved local changes. Export feedback JSON first if needed. Discard and load the Host version?
en.cutOverlap: This range includes source pixels already moved away. Drag the currently visible block instead; existing content and notes are unchanged.
en.keyboardHint: Space / middle button to pan · Ctrl/Cmd+Z to undo · Arrow keys to nudge blocks
